name: Iyo Tesurai
source:
The current God-King of the Divine Kingdom of Tesurai, an island nation at the eastern end of the east.

The Tesurai family is considered gods themselves and is worshipped by the people. They rarely appear in public and have never left Tesurai.

They are said to be a family of gods who descended in human form to heal the world wounded by the Sealing War.

Although she succeeded as God-King at a young age after the death of the previous emperor, her role is largely symbolic, and practical affairs are mostly carried out by the regent, Yui.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1350333]Getchu[/url]]
